sections.title: Songs
sections.note: Notes are the N64's A and C buttons (▲ ▼ ◀ ▶); other versions map them to their own buttons.

items.name: Zelda's Lullaby
items.howTo: Impa teaches it as she escorts young Link out of the castle courtyard after he meets Zelda.
items.notes: ◀ ▲ ▶ ◀ ▲ ▶. Played on Triforce symbols, and to prove you're the Royal Family's messenger.

items.name: Saria's Song
items.howTo: Saria teaches it to young Link at the end of the meadow's maze, once he's met Zelda.
items.notes: ▼ ▶ ◀ ▼ ▶ ◀. Talks to Saria from anywhere, and cheers up Darunia and the Lost Woods Skull Kid.

items.name: Epona's Song
items.howTo: Talk to Malon in the corral as young Link with the Ocarina out, by day.
items.notes: ▲ ◀ ▶ ▲ ◀ ▶. Calls Epona as adult Link, and gets milk from cows.

items.name: Sun's Song
items.howTo: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce on the Royal Family's Tomb at the back of the graveyard, then read the inscription at the end of the tomb.
items.notes: ▶ ▼ ▲ ▶ ▼ ▲. Switches between day and night, and freezes ReDeads.

items.name: Song of Time
items.howTo: Dive for the Ocarina of Time in the moat by the castle town drawbridge after Zelda flees; she teaches it in a vision.
items.notes: ▶ A ▼ ▶ A ▼. Opens the Door of Time and moves blue Song of Time blocks.

items.name: Song of Storms
items.howTo: As adult Link, talk to the man with the music box in the windmill, then play it back to him.
items.notes: A ▼ ▲ A ▼ ▲. Young Link plays it in the windmill to drain the well, and it opens some grottos.

sections.title: Warp Songs
sections.note: Sheik teaches all six. The Scarecrow's Song you write yourself, so it isn't tracked.

items.name: Minuet of Forest
items.howTo: Sheik teaches it at the top of the meadow, by the Forest Temple, the first time adult Link goes there.
items.notes: A ▲ ◀ ▶ ◀ ▶. Warps to Sacred Forest Meadow.

items.name: Bolero of Fire
items.howTo: Sheik teaches it as adult Link enters the crater from the top of Death Mountain Trail.
items.notes: ▼ A ▼ A ▶ ▼ ▶ ▼. Warps to Death Mountain Crater.

items.name: Prelude of Light
items.howTo: Sheik teaches it when adult Link enters the Temple of Time after the Forest Temple.
items.notes: ▲ ▶ ▲ ▶ ◀ ▲. Warps to the Temple of Time.

items.name: Serenade of Water
items.howTo: Sheik teaches it at the end of the Ice Cavern, where you find the Iron Boots.

items.name: Nocturne of Shadow
items.howTo: Sheik teaches it in burning Kakariko Village when adult Link returns there with the Forest, Fire and Water Medallions.
items.notes: ◀ ▶ ▶ A ◀ ▶ ▼. Warps to the Shadow Temple's entrance in the graveyard.

items.name: Requiem of Spirit
items.howTo: Sheik teaches it when adult Link first reaches the Desert Colossus across the Haunted Wasteland.
items.notes: A ▼ A ▶ ▼ A. Warps to the Desert Colossus, which is how young Link gets there for his half of the Spirit Temple.
